items.title: The Glimchers Can’t Keep Up the Pace
items.summary: The mega gallery is struggling, Ebony L. Haynes joins Marian Goodman Gallery, longtime Manifesta director steps down, and more in Art Movements.

items.title: At MoMA, Brancusi Is Lost in Space
items.summary: The artist’s work is glorious and resonant, but the Museum of Modern Art has a space problem, or an elegance problem, or a crowd mitigation problem.

items.title: Shape Your Artistic Future at UC Davis: The Maria Manetti Shrem Art Studio MFA Program
items.summary: Generously funded, renowned faculty and visiting artists, spacious studios, and an exhibition at the Manetti Shrem Museum of Art.

items.title: Long-Lost Georgia O’Keeffe Landscape Goes to Auction
items.summary: Her painting “Near Abiquiu, New Mexico I” was stashed in an East Village closet for decades. Now it might sell for up to $3 million.
